name: Lawwwing
description: Add the Lawwwing Consent Management Platform (CMP) to the site.
project_description:
Integrate Lawwwing CMP into Drupal to automate cookie consent banners, privacy policies, and legal compliance with global data protection laws.

 Features 
 
 Automatically integrates Lawwwing’s Consent Management Platform (CMP) into your Drupal site. 
 Displays a fully compliant, customizable cookie banner supporting Google Consent Mode v2, IAB TCF v2.2, Microsoft UET, and Meta Consent Mode. 
 Generates and updates legal documents (Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, Terms, etc.) automatically, always aligned with current regulations. 
 Periodic site scanning detects new cookies, scripts, and services, updating policies without manual edits. 
 Multi-region compliance: GDPR (EU), ePrivacy, CCPA/CPRA (California), LGPD (Brazil), CPA (Colorado), and more. 
 Easy configuration directly within the Drupal admin interface. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Install and enable the module. 
 Go to Configuration → Lawwwing Settings . 
 Enter your Lawwwing Plugin ID (provided in your Lawwwing account). 
 Adjust banner style, language, and behavior to match your brand. 
 The module automatically injects scripts and updates documents — no coding required. 
 
 Once configured, your site will immediately begin showing the Lawwwing cookie banner and serving auto-updated legal texts.

 Additional Requirements 
 
 A valid Lawwwing account and API key. 
 Internet access from your Drupal installation to fetch configuration and updates from Lawwwing. 
 
 Supporting this Module 
 
 Official site: https://lawwwing.com 
 Documentation: https://docs.lawwwing.com 
 Support requests handled via Lawwwing customer support.
